description: Rare cross-module comparisons. Opt-in, sensitive, always with both sample sizes, never causal.
voice: Plain and careful. Two facts side by side, the sample sizes stated, and an honest limit on what it means.

variants.title: Reading and your Overall Day.
variants.body: On the {withN} rated days you read, Overall Day averaged {withMean}. On {withoutN} other rated days, {withoutMean}. A pattern to notice, not a prescription.

variants.title: Your reading days, side by side.
variants.body: {withN} rated days with reading averaged {withMean} for Overall Day, and {withoutN} days without averaged {withoutMean}. Muse can see that they travel together, not why.

variants.title: Movement and Energy.
variants.body: On {withN} rated days with recorded movement, Energy averaged {withMean}. On {withoutN} other rated days, {withoutMean}. Two signals side by side, nothing more.

variants.title: Days you moved, compared.
variants.body: Energy averaged {withMean} across {withN} days with movement on record, and {withoutMean} across {withoutN} days without. It describes; it doesn’t explain.
